{{PAGENAME}} is [[Horadric|Horadric's]] wife, the innkeeper of [[The Dead Horse]], and an ex-priestess.

She is one of three NPCs (the other two being [[Horadric]] and [[Vagner]]) present at the tavern on all of the six [[days]] irrespective of day/night.

==Quests==
===Visit Clotho===
After you brought back [[Ms. Charm]] the bad news about her {{Item|necklace}}, she wants Miss Chain's {{Item|perfume}}. In order to get it from her, you have to deliver a {{Item|Basket of food}} to her sister [[Clotho]], and bring back {{Item|Frog|12}} as ingredients for creating more {{Item|perfume}}. For this you'll receive  a total of 20 {{Happiness}} and you can get the {{Item|perfume}} from her.
